name: Munnar Tea Estates & Eravikulam National Park
opening_hours: 7:30 AM - 4:00 PM daily (Eravikulam closes mid-January to March for Nilgiri Tahr calving season)
rules: National park permits must be pre-booked online; safari minibuses transport visitors
Do not pluck tea leaves on private commercial estates
visual_features: rolling green hills contoured with manicured tea bushes enveloped in morning mountain mist under Anamudi peak
description: Munnar is a town located in the Idukki district of the southwestern Indian state of Kerala. Munnar is situated at around 1,600 metres (5,200 ft) above mean sea level, in the Western Ghats mountain range. This ancient plantation settlement, dominated by its tea industry, is also a growing modern hill station.
